copyPath.finding: OnSelectionTextChanged passes GetSelectedText to plugin SetSelectedText.
SetSelectedText stores UTF-8 text in selected_text_.
SelectionAsText returns selected_text_; Copy command delegates to caller.
getSelectedText message uses engine GetSelectedText; removes carriage returns only.

conclusion: The normal body-copy payload and the automated selection payload share the same extraction function in the source tag matching the installed browser version. This supports retaining observed character/order failures; it is not native clipboard execution or a proof that the installed binary exactly equals this source build.
